pipeline_order: Station_name-wise linear interpolate min_temp, max_temp (limit_direction=both) on FULL series
Station_name-wise median fill residual min_temp, max_temp on FULL series
Station_name-wise median fill wind_speed, air_pressure on FULL series
Chronological split by TARGET date only when building sequences

leakage_classification.explanation: Rainfall is never imputed; target day is excluded from X. Only covariates (temps via linear+median; wind/pressure via median) can use post-2022 observations when filling train-period gaps.
leakage_classification.refined: Dominant path is station-median fill of wind_speed and air_pressure before split. Temperature linear interpolation does not cross the 2022/2023 boundary. Only 3.2% of h=1 train sequences contain any future-dependent covariate day.

validity_conclusion.caveat: Directionally valid for model comparison; not free of preprocessing covariate leakage. Do not claim leakage-free preprocessing.
validity_conclusion.recommended_change: Fit interpolate/median using only dates <= train_end, then transform val/test. Run a sensitivity retrain if thesis claims hinge on exact RMSE.

median_shift_magnitudes.note: delta = |full-series station median - train-only station median| for train missing rows where they differ

temp_linear_cross_split_gaps.interpretation: No train-period missing temperature uses a post-2022 observation as the next linear-interpolation endpoint.
